title: Ecological Testing Station 07
description: Imperial testing laboratory. Contains botanical research data, water storage filters, and high-tech components.

title: Research Outpost Beta
description: Old botanical testing station. Requires laser cutter to breach secondary bulkhead.

title: Smuggler Heavy Corvette Wreck
description: Crashed cargo hauler. Heavy salvage potential, high radiation zone in reactor core.

title: Harkonnen Frigate Debris Field
description: Scattered fuselage sections. Guarded by scavengers. Rich in composite plating and energy cells.

title: Deep Sand Basin Blow Alpha
description: Pre-spice mass eruption site. High sandworm hazard; bring thumper decoy.

title: Eastern Dune Field Spice Mass
description: Active spice field. Periodic eruptions yield high purity raw melange.

title: Ancient Qanat Siphon Well
description: Deep subterranean water basin. Provides reliable dew-condenser recharge.

title: Wind-Trap Ridge Extraction Site
description: High altitude cliff face suited for large scale atmospheric moisture collection.

title: Sietch Outlier Shelter
description: Natural rock overhang providing shade and respite from Coriolis storms.

title: Vermilion Gorge Pass
description: Narrow canyon path connecting northern dunes to central basin. Low worm threat.

title: Smuggler Black Market Merchant
description: Independent trader dealing in weapon schematics, water rings, and contraband gear.

title: Swordmaster Training Enclave
description: Ginaz sword combat master. Unlocks melee stance skills and defensive abilities.

title: The High Anvil Overlook
description: Major geographical landmark visible across Hagga Basin.

title: Southern Gateway Beacon
description: Ornithopter waypoint and fast travel transit point.

title: Great Erg Central Blow
description: Massive continuous spice eruption. Extreme Shai-Hulud activity.

title: Lost Dreadnought Graveyard
description: Massive military cruiser hull half-submerged in the shifting sands.

title: Ancient Spice Silo Complex
description: Sub-surface vault holding preserved guild navigation fuel caches.
